subject: Question regarding the SE in parameterEstimates() and standardizedSolution()

messages.author: c0b85026c3b3c859
messages.subject: Question regarding the SE in parameterEstimates() and standardizedSolution()
parts:
Hello,

I am using lavaan to compute a CFA with categorical data and would like to report the standardized estimates including their standard errors and p-value. I came across two aspects that confuse me:
1) The standard errors given by the functions parameterEstimates(., standardized=TRUE) as well as summary(., standardized=TRUE), which show the same values, differ from the SE values the function standardizedSolution() reports.
2) Each time the function standardizedSolution() is called, it produces slightly different SE and therefore p-values.
I could reproduce this behaviour with the Holzinger-Swineford dataset. Although in this case the different SE values do not lead to different p-values. My question is which function I should use to report the SE for the standardized estimates? Given the case, it is better to use the values from the function standardizedSolutions(). Is there a possibility to provide a seed for the calculation to obtain reproducible results?

Thanks in advance!
Emanuel
